message: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in axios.
aiExplanation: The installed version of axios has a known Server-Side Request Forgery vulnerability. This can allow an attacker to make unauthorized requests from the server.

message: Potential SQL injection vulnerability. User input is directly concatenated into a SQL query.
snippet: const query = 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = \'' + req.body.username + '\'';
aiExplanation: Directly concatenating user input into SQL queries exposes the database to SQL injection attacks, where attackers can manipulate the query logic to access or destroy data.
aiFix:
const query = 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?';
db.execute(query, [req.body.username]);
